input.topic: Vitamin Deficiencies: Component Of NAD+ And NADP+

expected.question_text: A 56-year-old female presents to the primary care physician with a complaint of a facial rash for the past month. She has had diarrhea for the past week, and her husband said that she has some problems with memory. She was diagnosed with latent tuberculosis and has received appropriate treatment over the past four months. Vital signs reveal: | Temperature | 36.7°C (98.0°F) | |---|---| | Blood pressure | 110/70 mmHg | | Heart rate | 73/min | | Respiratory rate | 17/min | Mini-mental status examination reveals a score of 21/30. Skin examination reveals eczematous changes along the face and neck. Which of the following is the function of the vitamin deficient in this patient?
expected.explanation_header: The correct answer is Component of NAD+and NADP+.
